title: OpenClaude – Free Open-Source Terminal Coding Agent for Any LLM
description:
OpenClaude is a free, open-source coding assistant CLI that works with cloud and local models like OpenAI, Gemini, and Ollama. Install it with one npm command and start coding in your terminal.
